description: This file defines a PHP trait 'PasswordStrengthServiceTrait' that provides a method to access the 'PasswordStrengthService' instance, utilizing dependency injection through a service container. It is designed to be used in classes that require password strength validation functionality within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getPasswordStrengthService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PasswordStrengthService obtained from the service container.
